Welcome to Shamanicca (shamanicca.com). These Terms & Conditions govern your use of our website and the purchase of products through our online store. By accessing this website or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our website.

Questions? Reach us at contact@shamanicca.com before placing an order.

1. About Us

This website is operated by Shamanicca, a spiritually-rooted lifestyle and content creation brand. Throughout these terms, “we,” “us,” and “our” refer to Shamanicca. Our products are fulfilled on demand through Printful and shipped globally.

2. Eligibility

By using this site, you confirm that:

  • You are at least the age of majority in your country or region, or you have parental/guardian consent to use this site.
  • You will not use our products or website for any illegal or unauthorized purpose.

3. Products

We make every effort to display accurate product descriptions, images, and pricing. However:

  • Colors and textures may appear slightly different on screen versus in person — this is inherent to print-on-demand production.
  • Product descriptions may contain occasional errors.
  • Availability is not guaranteed for all items at all times.

We reserve the right to limit quantities, discontinue products, or adjust pricing at any time without prior notice.

4. Orders

When you place an order, you confirm that:

  • All information provided (name, address, payment) is accurate and complete.
  • You are authorized to use the payment method submitted.

We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order if:

  • Fraud or unauthorized payment is suspected.
  • Product availability changes after the order is placed.
  • A pricing or product error was displayed on the site.

If an order is canceled after payment has been collected, a full refund will be issued to the original payment method.

5. Pricing & Payments

All prices are listed in USD (US Dollars) unless otherwise stated. Payments are processed securely through Stripe. We never store your full card details — all payment data goes directly to Stripe’s encrypted system.

By placing an order, you agree to pay:

  • The listed product price
  • Applicable shipping fees
  • Any applicable taxes or duties depending on your location

6. Shipping & Fulfillment

All orders are printed and fulfilled on demand through Printful. Production typically takes 2–5 business days before shipping. Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to:

  • Production volume and queue
  • Carrier delays
  • Customs or import processing
  • Force majeure events (weather, strikes, etc.)

We are not responsible for delays caused by shipping carriers or events beyond our control. An incorrect shipping address entered at checkout is the customer’s responsibility.

7. Returns & Refunds

Because every item is made to order, we do not accept returns for change of mind or size selection errors. We do cover:

  • Items that arrive damaged or defective
  • Wrong items sent by our fulfillment partner
  • Print errors or quality defects

For full details, please review our Returns & Exchanges Policy. Claims must be submitted within 7 days of delivery with photo evidence.

8. Product Use Disclaimer

Products and content sold on this website — including apparel, sacred objects, and editorial content — are intended for personal, spiritual, decorative, and educational use only. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical or psychological condition, and should not be interpreted as professional medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice. Shamanicca makes no therapeutic or healing claims for any product sold on this site.

9. Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including logos, branding, product designs, graphics, images, blog content, and design elements — is the property of Shamanicca or its content suppliers and is protected under applicable intellectual property laws.

You may not reproduce, distribute, modify, or commercially exploit any content from this site without prior written permission from Shamanicca.

10. User Content

If you submit reviews, comments, photos, or other content to our site or social channels, you grant Shamanicca a non-exclusive, royalty-free right to use, reproduce, modify, and publish that content for marketing or operational purposes.

You agree not to submit content that is unlawful, offensive, defamatory, or misleading.

11. Prohibited Uses

You may not use this website to:

  • Engage in any unlawful activity
  • Transmit malicious code, spam, or unauthorized advertising
  • Infringe on the intellectual property rights of others
  • Harass, discriminate against, or harm other users
  • Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
  • Scrape, copy, or republish content without permission

12. Disclaimer of Warranties

This website and all products are provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the website will be uninterrupted, error-free, or completely secure at all times.

13. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Shamanicca shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of our website or products. In all cases, our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the product giving rise to the claim.

14. Third-Party Services

Our store operates with the following third-party services:

  • Stripe — payment processing
  • Printful — order production and fulfillment
  • Vercel — website hosting
  • Google Analytics — site analytics

We are not responsible for the policies, practices, or interruptions of any third-party service.

15. Privacy

Your use of this website is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated into these Terms by reference. Please review it to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data.

16. Changes to These Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon posting. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will reflect any revisions. Continued use of the website after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.

17. Governing Law

These Terms & Conditions are governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Province of Quebec, Canada, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Quebec.

18. Contact

If you have any questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact us:

Shamanicca
Email: contact@shamanicca.com
Website: shamanicca.com
